regions.name: Primera/Postrera areas (rest of the country)
regions.where: All areas outside the Western Highlands: the Dry Corridor, the east, the Pacific coast and the north; rows marked 'North' apply to northern Guatemala
regions.notes: First Rainy Season May 1 to mid-Jul; Second Rainy Season Aug 1 to mid-Nov. Lean box May-Aug (the box labelled just 'Lean Season'). Primera planting Apr-Jun, harvest Sep. Postrera planting mid-Aug to mid-Oct, harvest Nov to mid-Dec. 'North' Postrera bars: planting mid-Nov through Jan (continues as the unlabelled Jan bar), weeding Jan-Feb, harvest Feb-Mar; they are planted after the shaded rains end but are labelled Postrera.

regions.name: Western Highlands
regions.where: The western highland (Altiplano) departments, from the rows and lean box labelled 'Western Highlands'
regions.notes: Single long cycle: land preparation Feb to mid-Apr, planting Mar-May, weeding Jul-Aug, main harvest Nov to mid-Dec. Harvest linked to the First Rainy Season because the crop is sown with it, but it grows through both rainy seasons. Western Highlands lean box Jun-Sep. Frost risk Nov-Feb.

assign.method: No titled blocks, but rows and a lean box are labelled 'Western Highlands', so two regions: the Altiplano departments (Huehuetenango, Quiché, San Marcos, Quetzaltenango, Totonicapán, Sololá, Chimaltenango, plus Sacatepéquez) to western-highlands, all others to primera-postrera; adm2 overrides send the San Marcos and Quetzaltenango coastal/boca-costa municipalities and Ixcán (Quiché) to primera-postrera.

transcriber_notes: Edges drawn at mid-month are counted (at-least-half rule); the end of the First Rainy Season (mid-Jul), the end of the Second Rainy Season (mid-Nov), the start of Postrera planting (mid-Aug) and the end of the Postrera harvest (mid-Dec) are at mid-month. The calendar has no locator map; the Western Highlands department list and the 'North' scope come from geographic knowledge, not the image. Sacatepéquez (central highlands) placed in western-highlands with low confidence. The 'North' Postrera bars are kept inside primera-postrera rather than made a separate region.
